AI Voice Generator 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly generate 1080p voiceover video clips from product description scripts (up to 200 words).
- No local installation needed — text to voiced video in 20–40 seconds via cloud processing.
- Supports natural-sounding voiceovers and customizable requests (e.g., voice, aspect ratio, overlays).
- Automated setup: free token issuance and session management on first use.
- Multiple export formats: MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, GIF, MP3, WAV, and more.
- User-friendly error handling and instructions for seamless editing and exporting.
